Handwritten IMDb-shaped fixtures for alternative-title tests. Not copied from
IMDb: identifiers and well-known localized titles are illustrative, vote counts
are invented, `tt9999902` is fictional (an unrelated title that shares the
French alias "La Reine des neiges"), and several rows are deliberately
malformed or low-value (working, literal, 3-D version, original, wrong
language, shared region without a language).
